scripts.build: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/design-tokens run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-starter run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-denali run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-urban run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/ui-primitives run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/theme-react run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/tenant-kernel run build && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-events run build && pnpm --filter @apps/api run build && pnpm --filter @apps/marketing run build && pnpm --filter @apps/portal run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk run lint && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run lint && eslint "packages/workspace-sdk/src/**/*.ts" "packages/platform-core/src/**/*.ts" --ignore-pattern "**/*.spec.ts"
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-phase-7-genericity-proof-rev.mjs && pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/design-tokens run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-starter run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-urban run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/ui-primitives run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/theme-react run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/tenant-kernel run test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-events run test && pnpm --filter @apps/api run test && pnpm --filter @apps/web run test
scripts.test:adversarial: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk exec -- env NODE_ENV=test node --import tsx --test test/adversarial-canonical-ingress.spec.ts test/storage-ingress-immutability.spec.ts && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core exec -- env NODE_ENV=test node --import tsx --test test/adversarial-validation.spec.ts test/adversarial-plugin-ingress.spec.ts test/rule-engine-concurrency.spec.ts test/runtime-isolation.spec.ts
scripts.test:nightly: pnpm --filter @apps/api run test:nightly && pnpm --filter @apps/api run test:nightly:soak
scripts.infra:up: DB_PORT=5434 docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis minio && pnpm infra:minio:ensure-bucket
scripts.infra:minio:ensure-bucket: docker run --rm --network host --entrypoint /bin/sh minio/mc -c 'mc alias set local http://127.0.0.1:9002 minioadmin minioadmin && mc mb local/app-tour-dev --ignore-existing'
scripts.test:minio-photo: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-denali... run build && pnpm --filter @apps/api exec node --import tsx --test test/minio-photo.spec.ts
scripts.phase-0:foundation-adversarial: pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-sdk exec -- env NODE_ENV=test node --import tsx --test test/adversarial-canonical-ingress.spec.ts test/storage-ingress-immutability.spec.ts
scripts.phase-0:integration-gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run test:contract:monorepo && pnpm run test:adversarial && DOC_SYNC_SCOPE=foundation pnpm run guard:doc-sync && PHASE_0_GUARD_REPORT=integration node scripts/guards/phase-0-guard.mjs && pnpm run guard:architecture && pnpm run guard:import-boundary && pnpm run baseline:metrics
scripts.phase-0:gate: pnpm run phase-0:foundation-gate && pnpm run phase-0:integration-gate
scripts.phase-1:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run test:phase-1 && pnpm run guard:architecture && pnpm run guard:import-boundary && pnpm run guard:symlink && pnpm run phase-1:guard
scripts.phase-2:gate: pnpm run check:node-engine && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/platform-core run test:phase-2 && pnpm run guard:architecture && pnpm run guard:import-boundary && pnpm run validate-design-tokens && pnpm run guard:artifact-surface && pnpm run audit-boundary && pnpm run phase-2:guard
scripts.phase-3:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run guard:architecture && pnpm run guard:import-boundary && pnpm run guard:artifact-surface && pnpm run audit-boundary && pnpm run phase-2:gate && pnpm run doc-gate && pnpm run phase-3:guard
scripts.phase-4:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run phase-3:gate && pnpm run phase-4:guard
scripts.phase-5:gate: pnpm run db:test-reset && env P5_PERF_GATE_MS=850 MIN_THROUGHPUT=100 BASELINE_RATIO_MAX=1.25 PHASE_5_GATE_REPORT=2026-06-05 pnpm build && env P5_PERF_GATE_MS=850 MIN_THROUGHPUT=100 BASELINE_RATIO_MAX=1.25 pnpm test && env P5_PERF_GATE_MS=850 pnpm run phase-4:gate && env PHASE_5_GATE_REPORT=2026-06-05 pnpm run phase-5:guard
scripts.phase-6:fast-track: nvm use && pnpm run pre-commit:fast && pnpm run guard:import-boundary && pnpm run phase-6:guard
scripts.phase-6:fast-closure: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @app-tour/workspace-denali test && pnpm run phase-5:guard && pnpm run phase-6:guard
scripts.phase-6:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run phase-5:gate && pnpm run phase-6:guard
scripts.phase-7:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run phase-6:gate && pnpm run phase-7:guard
scripts.phase-8:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run phase-7:gate && pnpm run phase-8:guard
scripts.phase-9:gate: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm run phase-8:gate && pnpm run phase-9:guard
scripts.build:operator-vps: pnpm --filter @apps/api... run build && pnpm --filter @apps/web... run build
